strings.title: NUL_SENTINEL
strings.subtitle: Problem: missing values
strings.briefing:
Station telemetry came back with holes in it. 23 readings in temp_c never wrote — the sensor dropped frames, and pandas is showing you NaN where a number should be.

The Sentinel is not a monster standing next to your data. It is the absence inside it. Fill every gap in temp_c and it has nowhere left to live.

df is loaded. 240 rows, 6 columns.
strings.task: The temp_c column has 23 empty (missing) values. Fill every empty value with a sensible number, such as the column's average, so that no gaps are left.

starterCode.python:
# df is loaded. 240 rows, 6 columns.
# Inspect first, then fix.
df.isna().sum()

python: Start by counting the gaps: df.isna().sum() shows nulls per column.
Pick a fill value that makes sense for temperatures, such as the column mean: df['temp_c'].fillna(df['temp_c'].mean()).
Assign the result back: df['temp_c'] = df['temp_c'].fillna(df['temp_c'].mean())
sql: Count the gaps first: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data WHERE temp_c IS NULL;
Use a subquery for the replacement value: (SELECT AVG(temp_c) FROM data).
UPDATE data SET temp_c = (SELECT AVG(temp_c) FROM data) WHERE temp_c IS NULL;
